entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Ya-Seen. (These are individual letters of the Arabic alphabet; Allah and His Messenger know their exact meanings.)
By the oath of the wise Qur'aan.
You (O Beloved) have been sent (as a Messenger).
(You are) upon the Straight Path.
Sent down by the Dignified, the Merciful.
In order that you may warn those people whose forefathers were not warned; hence, they are unaware.
Undoubtedly, the Word (of punishment) has been proven against most of them; consequently, they will not believe.
We have indeed put shackles around their necks, reaching up to the chins; hence, they remain facing upwards.
And We have set a barrier in front of them and a barrier behind them, and covered them from above; consequently, they see nothing.
And it is the same for them, whether you warn them or warn them not; they are not to believe.
You warn only him who follows the advice and fears the Most Gracious without seeing; therefore, give him glad tidings of forgiveness and an honourable reward.

Undoubtedly, We will bring the dead to life and We are recording what they have sent ahead and the signs which they have left behind. And We have kept counted all things in a disclosing Book (i.e. the Preserved Tablet).
And relate to them an example of the people of that city, when envoys came to them.
When We had sent two (envoys) towards them and they belied them, so We strengthened them with a third, now they all said, ‘Indeed, we have been sent to you.'
They said, 'You are not but humans like us, and the Most Gracious has not sent down anything; you are merely liars.'
They responded, 'Our Lord knows that we have indeed definitely been sent towards you.'
'And our duty is nothing but to clearly convey (the message).'
They (the people of the city) said, 'We think of you as bad luck. Indeed, if you do not desist, we shall surely stone you; you will certainly face a grievous punishment by our hands.'
They responded, 'Your bad luck is just with you. Are you getting annoyed with being advised? Rather, you are a people who exceed the limits.'
And from the furthermost side of the city came a man running (a Muslim by the name of Habeeb Najjaar). He said, 'O my people! Obey the sent ones.'
'Obey those who do not ask from you any reward, and they are on the straight path.'
'And what (hindrance) do I have for not worshipping Him Who has created me? And towards only Him you are to return?'
'Shall I appoint other gods except Allah? That if the Most Gracious intends any harm to me, so their intercession would be of no use to me, nor would they be able to save me.'
'Undoubtedly, I am then clearly in error.'
'I have certainly believed in your Lord, so listen to me.'
It was said to him, 'Enter Paradise.' He said, 'Somehow, had my people known.'
'How my Lord has forgiven me and made me amongst the honoured ones.'
And thereafter, We did not send down an army from the heaven against his people, nor were We to send down any army there.
It was just one shriek; they immediately became extinct.
And it was said that 'Woe to those bondsmen! When a Messenger comes to them, so they ridicule him.'
Have they not seen how many generations We have destroyed before them, that they are now not to return to them?
And however many there are, all of them will be brought forth in Our Majestic Court.
And a sign for them is the dead earth; We revived it and then We produced from it grains, so they eat therefrom.
And We have made in it gardens of dates and grapes, and We have made some springs to flow therein.
That they may eat from its fruits, and these (gardens of fruits) are not created by their hands, so will they not acknowledge the right (of Allah)?
Purity is to Him Who created all, in pairs, from those things what the earth produces, and (He also made pairs) from themselves and from those things of which they have no knowledge.
And a sign for them is the night from which We draw out (the light of) the day, thereupon they are in darkness.
And the sun moves towards its final point (i.e. the Day of Judgement); this is the command of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
And We have appointed phases for the moon till it becomes like a dried (i.e. curved) branch of a date tree.
It is not befitting for the sun to overtake the moon (during the night), nor does the night surpass the day; and each one of them is floating in an orbit.
And a sign for them is that We carried them in a loaded ship (i.e. the Ark of Nooh), while they were in the loins of their forefathers.
And We have created for them similar boats, in which they ride.
And if We will, We may henceforth drown them; so, there would be no one to help them, nor would they be saved.
But by the Mercy from Us, and to allow enjoyment for a while.
And when it is said to them, 'Fear that which is in front of you, and that which is to come after you; with this hope that you may attain mercy.' So, they turn away.
And whenever a sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord; so, they turn their faces away.

And when it is said to them, 'Spend some in His path out of that which Allah has provided.' So, the disbelievers say regarding the Muslims that 'Shall we feed him whom, had Allah willed, He would have therefore fed? You are not but in open error.'
And they say, 'When will this promise come, if you are truthful?'
They await not but just for that one scream, which will seize them while they are caught up in worldly disputes.
So, neither will they be able to make a will nor return to their homes.
And the Trumpet will be blown at once; they will run towards their Lord from their graves.
They will say, 'Woe to us! Who has awakened us from (our place of) sleep? This is that which the Most Gracious had promised, and the Messengers had spoken the truth.'
It will not be but just one scream, and every one of them will immediately gather in Our Majestic Court.
So, on this Day, no soul will be wronged in the least, and you will not be recompensed except for what you did.
Verily, the dwellers of Paradise on this Day will be enjoying heart-desired entertainment with satisfaction.
They and their wives are beneath (pleasant) shades, reclining upon thrones.
For them in it are fruits and they will have whatever they ask for.
Upon them will be 'Salaam (i.e. peace),' mentioned by the Merciful Lord.
(It will be commanded) 'And keep yourselves apart today (from the believers), O you criminals.'
'O children of Adam! Did I not take a covenant from you that you should not worship the Devil? Undoubtedly, he is your open enemy.'
'And you must worship Me; this is the Straight Path.'
'And he has indeed misled a large number of you; so, did you not have sense?'
'This is that Hell, of which you were promised.'
'Enter in it today; the recompense of your disbelief.'
This Day We shall set a seal on their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will bear witness to what they used to do.
And had We willed, We could have consequently wiped out their eyes, then they would have rushed towards the path; so, they would not have perceived.
And had We so willed, We could have henceforth disfigured their faces while they were in their homes, that they would not have been able to go forward nor turn back.
And whomever We give long life, We reverse him in creation (i.e. making him go back to weakness after strength). So, do they not understand?
And We have neither taught him (i.e. the Beloved Prophet Muhammad) to recite poetry, nor does it befit his dignity. That (what he recites to you) is nothing but advice and the Luminous Qur'aan.
That it may warn the one who is alive (i.e. a believer), and the Word (of punishment) be proven against the disbelievers.
And did they not see that We have created for them cattle, which are made by Our Hand (of power), so they are their owners?
And (We) have subjected the animals for them, so they ride some and they eat some.
And for them therein are numerous benefits and drinks; so, will they not be grateful?
And they have appointed other gods except Allah, that perhaps they be helped.
And they cannot help them, and they together with their armies will be brought as captives.
So, you (O Beloved), do not grieve over what they say. Indeed, We are aware of what they conceal and what they disclose.
And did man not see that We have created him from a drop of fluid (i.e. sperm)? He is openly quarrelsome straightaway.
And he mentions an example for Us, and forgot his own being created. He stated, 'Who is such that can revive the bones when they have become disintegrated?'
Say you (O Beloved), 'The One Who created them initially will revive them, and He is aware of all (aspects of) creation.'
'The One Who has created for you fire out of the green tree (i.e. this particular tree grows in Arabia), you ignite from it instantly, whenever you want.'
And the One Who created the heavens and the earth; can He not create more of the likes of them? Why not? And only He is the Supreme Creator, the Knower of everything.
And His action is only this; that when He intends (to create) anything, so He (only) says to it, 'Be,' it immediately becomes.
So, glorified is He in Whose Hand is the control of everything, and towards only Him you will be returned.
